candidates.title: Document reports functionality and requirements
candidates.statement: The system shall have a documented specification that describes optimal Reports functionality for a future Evergreen release and includes a list of requirements.
candidates.source_quote: "Document optimal Reports functionality within a future Evergreen release and develop a list of requirements."

candidates.title: Use Galecia King County draft as foundation
candidates.statement: The system's requirements specification shall be based on and adapt the King County / Galecia Group draft reports Software Requirements Specification to PINES-specific needs.
candidates.source_quote: "PINES staff decided to use that as a foundation and adapt it for our specific needs."

candidates.title: Working group filters reports development
candidates.statement: All new Reports development for PINES shall be filtered through and tested by the Reports Working Group (the group shall act as the Reports testing group).
candidates.source_quote: "Become the Reports testing group, through which all new Reports development would be filtered."

candidates.title: Compile Executive Reports Interface list
candidates.statement: The system shall include a compiled list of reports required for an Executive Reports Interface.
candidates.source_quote: "Compile a list of reports needed for an Executive Reports Interface."

candidates.title: Create report templates for PINES libraries
candidates.statement: The system shall determine and create report templates needed for all PINES libraries.
candidates.source_quote: "Determine and create templates needed for all PINES libraries."

candidates.title: Collection and usage analysis reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports and analysis tools to analyze the library collection and its use by patrons.
candidates.source_quote: "Analyzing the Library collection and its use by patrons"

candidates.title: Branch capacity and distribution analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports and analysis tools to analyze branch capacity and the optimal distribution of the collection across branches.
candidates.source_quote: "Analyzing branch capacity and optimal distribution of the collection"

candidates.title: Patron demographics and interests analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports and analysis tools to analyze patron demographics and interests.
candidates.source_quote: "Analyzing demographics and interests of patrons"

candidates.title: Staff productivity and workflow analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports and analysis tools to analyze staff productivity and workflow.
candidates.source_quote: "Analyzing staff productivity and workflow"

candidates.title: Financial transaction tracking and verification
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports and tools for tracking and verifying financial transactions.
candidates.source_quote: "Tracking and verifying financial transactions"

candidates.title: Restrict scope to management processes
candidates.statement: The system's reports scope shall focus on Management Processes (reports and analysis tools used by managers, administrators, and staff for planning, evaluation, and oversight).
candidates.source_quote: "the group would focus on Management Processes - that is, reports and analysis tools used by library managers, administrators, and staff"

candidates.title: Exclude patron-facing OPAC/circulation functions
candidates.statement: The system shall exclude day-to-day patron-facing OPAC and circulation client functions from the Management Processes reports specification.
candidates.source_quote: "this does NOT include day-to-day patron-facing functions (those are part of the OPAC and circulation client)."

candidates.title: Support Patron indirect report access
candidates.statement: The system shall support Patrons as a user class who may access report output indirectly, for example via displays/screens at libraries, while primary patron interactions remain via the OPAC.
candidates.source_quote: "Patrons interact through OPAC; they may use reports indirectly through displays/screens at libraries"

candidates.title: Enable staff as report content creators
candidates.statement: The system shall provide report creation and editing capabilities for paid library Staff, recognizing staff as primary content creators for reports.
candidates.source_quote: "Staff are our primary content creators for reports"

candidates.title: Local configuration by Local System Administrators
candidates.statement: The system shall allow Local System Administrators (management staff at local branches) to configure the system locally.
candidates.source_quote: "Local System Administrators: ... They configure the system locally."

candidates.title: Interfaces for Library Managers
candidates.statement: The system shall provide interfaces and reporting features that enable Library Managers to supervise a single organizational unit and provide input to report design and implementation.
candidates.source_quote: "Library Managers: Supervise a single organizational unit and provide input to design and implementation of Library services."

candidates.title: Support for Library Directors' planning needs
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reporting features that support Library Directors (executive-level stakeholders) in planning and directing library services and priorities.
candidates.source_quote: "Library Directors: Members of the Library Executive Team who plan and direct Library services and priorities."

candidates.title: Consortium-level administration and reporting
candidates.statement: The system shall provide Global System Administrators consortium-level capabilities to implement software changes and configurations and to generate statistical reports for PINES as a whole.
candidates.source_quote: "Global System Administrator: ... implementing software changes and configurations, and generating statistical reports for PINES as a whole."

candidates.title: Role-based access control for report functions
candidates.statement: The system shall implement role-based access control that grants appropriate permissions for report creation, configuration, generation, and administrative tasks to the defined user classes.
candidates.source_quote: "They configure the system locally...generating statistical reports for PINES as a whole."

candidates.title: SRS intended audience and readability
candidates.statement: The Software Requirements Specification (SRS) shall be written for both library managers and staff who may contribute requirements and for software project managers and developers, balancing readability for non-technical audiences with specificity for developers.
candidates.source_quote: "intended both for library managers and staff ... and for software project managers and developers"

candidates.title: Iterative prototype-oriented development
candidates.statement: The system and its UI and data structures shall be specified using an iterative, prototype-oriented methodology with multiple opportunities for end-user review of prototypes.
candidates.source_quote: "UI and data structures would require further specification using an iterative, prototype-oriented methodology."

candidates.title: Defer detailed UI specification
candidates.statement: Detailed user interface specifications shall be deferred until later iterative prototype work; initial requirements shall focus on functional requirements.
candidates.source_quote: "for now the focus should be on functional requirements"

candidates.title: Specify only management-related requirements
candidates.statement: The project shall specify only requirements that directly or indirectly relate to management activities and not attempt to fully specify unrelated ILS modules.
candidates.source_quote: "The group agreed to specify only those requirements that directly or indirectly relate to management activities."

candidates.title: Acquisitions and Cataloging separate specifications
candidates.statement: Acquisitions and Cataloging modules shall be specified in separate specifications and not within this Management Processes reports specification.
candidates.source_quote: "PINES is currently working on separate specifications for Acquisitions and Cataloging modules."

candidates.title: Member interviews to gather report needs
candidates.statement: The project shall collect report needs by having each working group member conduct at least one interview with staff at their library system, with findings due by April 15, 2009.
candidates.source_quote: "Each member will conduct at least one interview with staff at their library system to gather report needs (due by April 15, 2009)"

candidates.title: Circulate King County/Galecia draft
candidates.statement: The project shall circulate the King County / Galecia Group draft reports specification to working group members for reference.
candidates.source_quote: "Katherine will circulate the King County / Galecia Group draft for reference"

candidates.title: Schedule follow-up meeting
candidates.statement: The project shall hold a follow-up working group meeting on July 20, 2009 to review findings from member interviews and other work.
candidates.source_quote: "A follow-up meeting is scheduled for July 20, 2009 to review findings"

candidates.title: Technical subcommittee on architectural constraints
candidates.statement: The project shall form a technical subcommittee and hold a meeting in late June to discuss architectural constraints for Reports functionality.
candidates.source_quote: "A technical subcommittee meeting will be held in late June to discuss architectural constraints"

candidates.title: Assume reader familiarity with library terminology
candidates.statement: The SRS shall assume readers have a general understanding of library services and processes and shall not define common library terminology.
candidates.source_quote: "It was assumed that readers have a general understanding of Library services and processes and do not require definition of common Library terminology."
